text: Zainab's pregnant!! Due sometime in the spring, she thinks April. Off caffeine completely and says the smell of coffee makes her gag now.
Lunch w Pedro. He's gone vegan since the summer, properly strict, no honey even. Wants to open a little taco van at some point.
Mihai and his wife Dorota had the baby, a girl, Tuesday at 4am. Need to send flowers before the weekend.
christening for baby Noah is Sunday June 8th at 11am, St Brigid's. Colm asked me to be godparent, still can't quite believe it
Note to self: dentist moved to Thursday at 2.15. Bring the form.
Abdi mentioned his sister Yara is expecting twins. Due early next year. He's buzzing, going to be an uncle twice over. Must ask him if they've found out what they're having.
Hannah can't do gluten, coeliac, so no pastry when she comes over. She does love a good risotto though.
call from Jun - his mum's in hospital again, scan tomorrow morning at 9. He sounded wrecked. ring him tomorrow evening to see how it went
Francesca says the baby shower is March 14 at 1pm at her aunt's. Bring something small, she's registered at the baby shop on the high street.
Lorenzo only drinks Negronis. Literally nothing else at the bar all night. Good to know for his birthday sometime in November.

So I was talking to Grace after book club and she said her daughter Esme is pregnant with her first, they're telling everyone after the 12 week scan which is next Wednesday. Grace is over the moon but also a bit nervous because Esme had a rough time last year. Don't say anything to anyone yet. Ask Grace how the scan went on Thursday.
ravi lactose intolerant. oat milk only. remember for the work away day
Mandla's leaving do was cancelled, the restaurant double booked. Rescheduling after Christmas apparently.
Wiremu and Joy are flying out to Auckland on 12/20 to show the new baby to his family. Back sometime mid January.
Victor got the job at the brewery!! Starts Monday 8am. Text him congrats tonight.
Chioma's son Tiago has a peanut allergy, carries an EpiPen. Noting so I don't bring the satay to the party on Saturday.
Paolo nervous about his citizenship test on May 6 at 10:30. Wish him luck the night before.

um so Dana rang, she's finally booked the christening, it's going to be the 21st, I think September? at half eleven, and then lunch at the Fox after. she wants me to do a reading. right, need to pick a reading by the end of the month
Lucy's off sugar for Lent. Again. Don't offer her the brownies.
Blessing had her baby boy last night, 7lb 2oz, named him after his grandad. Both doing well. Chip in for the group gift from work.
Pick up oat milk, nappies for Zainab's hamper, birthday card. Post office before 5.
Jack and his partner Rafael are adopting! Still early, panel is sometime in the new year. He seemed calm about it but I know he's anxious underneath.
Sunil said he's doing Veganuary with his brother Chen. Asked me to join. Maybe. Chen hates mushrooms btw, keep in mind for dinner on Jan 9 at 7.
Aurelio - big wine guy, Barolo especially. Hinted that a decent corkscrew would be appreciated, his broke at the weekend.
Pedro's wife Lucy had the baby last Friday. Haven't messaged yet, terrible. Do it today.
Hannah's dad recovering after his hip op on Oct 3. She's been driving up every weekend. Check in with her soon.
quick one - Colm's partner is pregnant, due 2/14 of all days. He's terrified. Wants to be ready with the nursery done before Christmas.
Mihai's baby girl is called Ana. Dorota wants visitors only after the first couple of weeks so maybe early next month.
Joy messaged: gender reveal party has been called off, her mum isn't well. Send her a note.
Abdi doesn't drink, halal too, so I'll sort the food for Friday's dinner myself. Booking the Lebanese place for 7:30.
Dr Okafor said Grace's daughter's due date moved to June 3rd. Grace said she'll fly over for a few weeks after.
Noah turns one on April 22 - party at the soft play, 2pm. Colm says he's obsessed with dinosaurs. Dino book?
Ran into Esme in Tesco. Bump showing! She's craving pickles and ice cream, apparently it's a real thing. Feeling much better than the first trimester.
Zainab and her husband are struggling with the nursery move, landlord won't let them paint. They might move house sometime in the summer before the baby comes.
Meeting Yara Wednesday at 12:30 for lunch. She's pescatarian, so not the steak place.
Victor's sister Francesca is getting married next spring, date tbc. He wants to do a speech but is dreading it.
wiremu: allergic to shellfish (badly). his kids are fine with everything. remind me before the bbq on 7/4
Chioma's christening for her youngest got postponed - priest is ill. New date maybe after Easter.
Text Jun on the 18th first thing, it's his mum's 70th. She loves those almond biscuits from the Italian deli.
Ravi and his wife are expecting their second. Told me at the pub last night. Due around the end of summer. Their eldest is starting nursery in September too so a busy year.
Lorenzo's partner Dana - teetotal, loves elderflower cordial. Good for the hamper.
Need to book the car in for its MOT sometime next week. Morning slot ideally.
Rafael's mum's funeral is Monday the 14th at 10am. Jack's going with him. Should send a card to Rafael before then.
Mandla's wife Blessing is on bed rest for the last few weeks, pre-eclampsia scare. Mandla is doing all the cooking, mostly jollof and pasta. Drop round some meals at the weekend.
Grace's grandson's christening is next Sunday morning. I'm going to that, then dinner with Hannah in the evening.
Paolo loves spicy food, the hotter the better. Dislikes coriander though, says it tastes like soap.
Esme's baby arrived 10/16 at 3:40 in the morning! Little girl, Hannah, after her great-gran. Grace sent me about forty photos. Send a congrats card and the knitted blanket.
Tiago starting nursery on Aug 28 at 9. Chioma's more nervous than he is.
Dorota vegetarian but eats fish sometimes. Mihai eats anything. Their little one is on purees now, sweet potato mainly.
chat with Sunil about his job, he's moving teams at some point in the new year. Seems fine with it, no drama.

Pedro's sister Zainab - wait no, that's Pedro's cousin. Anyway she's expecting in May. He mentioned she's been really sick, can barely keep toast down. Pedro wants to organise a little surprise for her. Ask him what he's planning, maybe chip in.
Joy and Wiremu's son, Little Wim, nickname for Wiremu Jr, is getting christened at the Māori church on Nov 30 at 1pm. Whole whānau flying in. Joy is stressing about catering for 80.
Lunch tomorrow at 1 with Chen. Remember he's on keto, so the noodle bar is out.
Victor said Francesca's wedding is now June 21st, 4pm ceremony. He's finally written the speech.
Aurelio Petrov's wife is due on 3/9. He's taking six weeks paternity from the end of Feb. Ask him to lunch before he goes.
Blessing's little boy is being dedicated at church soon, probably early December. She asked if I could make my lemon drizzle for after.
Ravi's wedding anniversary is on 9/12, 10 years. He wants to surprise his wife with dinner somewhere fancy that does vegan tasting menus. Send him that list of restaurants.
Called Mum. Nothing new.
Yara had the twins!! Boy and girl, born yesterday afternoon at 5ish, a few weeks early but both fine. Abdi's flying out to see them on Saturday. Ask Abdi for photos when he's back.

Chat with Colm earlier today. Partner had a scan this morning at 8 and all looks good. He's relaxed a bit now. They're thinking about names, leaning towards Lucy if it's a girl. Christening will probably be sometime after the summer, his gran insists on it. I said I'd help with the food since half his family are veggie and his gran can't have dairy.
